author: reek
body: Per-chapter coverage for Conv2d, which had none before this file, plus the gpu-cmd family reached from a chapter that cites Conv2d rather than GpuProxy directly.

author: reek
body: It does NOT pin the name collision it was written alongside. Conv2d used to declare its own gpu-cmd-conv2d, -group-norm, -silu and -upsample2x next to GpuProxy's, and a citer resolved to GpuProxy's either way -- so the four-argument calls below compiled identically before those four definitions were removed. The instrument that sees the collision is CDX3006, which fired on all four and is silent now. A test cannot fail on it, so this one does not claim to.
